BiblicalUsage: Prognosis is foreknowledge, forethought, and Peter uses it twice at the heart of the gospel. Christ was delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, and believers are elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the cross was not an accident of history but the counsel of God, known before it happened.
